Marta: Quick poll — who's around to pick up a midweek snack drop today? Office coffee is getting dangerously low ☕️
Sam: I can swing by at 4pm. What should I grab? Any veg/vegan stuff?
Devon: I'll pick up oat milk and the GF granola from Whole Foods. Also can someone confirm espresso beans — we're almost out.
OpsBot: inventory-check: espresso_beans=2 bags, regular_milk=6 cartons, oat_milk=0, gf_granola=1 box. Reorder threshold for espresso_beans=3.
Liam: I have an extra bag of beans at home I can bring in. Happy to contribute. Please label with date though.
Anya: Poll: cookies 🍪 or fruit 🍎? React with :cookie: or :apple:
Marta: cookies 👍 (5 votes), fruit 🍎 (2 votes)
Sam: cookies + oat milk please
Devon: cookies if GF option available, otherwise fruit
Marta: noted. Plan: Sam picks general snacks (cookies + fruit backup), Devon grabs GF granola & oat milk, Liam brings one bag of espresso, I'll restock mugs + post inventory update.
Sam: shopping list:
```
- Chocolate chip cookies (2 packs)
- Mixed fruit (bananas + apples)
- Oat milk (2 cartons)
- Disposable cups (if mugs overflow)
```
Marta: Receipt? Drop it in #finance-expenses or DM me, I'll forward.
Liam: heads-up — please no tuna-salad lunches left overnight. Office fridge sin #1 😂
Anya: agreed. label-your-food policy applies
OpsBot: Inventory updated by Marta at 2026-03-18: espresso_beans=+1, oat_milk=+2, cookies=+2 packs
Sam: thanks everyone :heart:
